name: forjaia
description: ForjaIA — forja local self-hosted de software com agentes

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.start:local-prod: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production node scripts/check-local-prod.js && NODE_ENV=production npm run start --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:stable: concurrently "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
